regions.merged_text: God bless you Mrs. Helen Winke -- you and yours. I am glad you are still carying on. How wonderful -- the Good God has been to your Family; -- Indeed to us all! notwithsanding our many sins and stupidities. I surely hope the doctors get a favorable surprise when they come to operate on your Husband. I have enrolled him in the Emergency list of the Seraphic Mass Associan and that -- even that -- seems to work wonders at times.
